title: podocarpus hypophyllus
intro: Podocarpus hypophyllus, commonly known as the Yellow Podocarp, is a species of coniferous tree in the family Podocarpaceae. This plant is valued for its traditional medicinal uses and has been found to have various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Podocarpus hypophyllus include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antiviral and antifungal activities. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include podocarpic acid, 3-epipodocarpic acid, and other diterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
